name: Simple Animal Radius
author: irongete
description: A round patch laid on the ground under every aggressive animal in view, following it as it moves. Options > AddOns > Simple Animal Radius sets the radius, the fill's colour and opacity, the border's colour and thickness, and whether the world may hide the circle; its Animals... row opens the list, where each animal is ticked or unticked and a resource name of your own is added. The list and every row are remembered.
